jobs.title: SG0142: Regional Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst-Senior
jobs.description:
You will play a major role in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) in evaluation and action recommendation, financial analysis, forecasting and budgeting, business partnering. This regional role will present opportunities to work with various departments to provide financial service and consultancy which support the management team in making strategic business decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
- Financial Forecasting: Provide consolidated outlooks for both revenue and expenses at monthly basis; identify business implications and partners with stakeholders to execute targeted action items; explore improvement of forecast modelling and approaches to better meet the dynamic needs of the business.

- Annual Budgeting: Partner in budgeting cycle to set fiscal year goals which aligns with company’s strategic vision; stress-test budget assumptions and formalize action plans to address underlying variances or risks.

- Business Partnering: Collaborate with functional heads to review monthly spend analytics, identify variance and driving corrective actions to ensure expenses remain aligned with established fiscal targets.

- Profitability Analysis: Evaluate actual profitability outcome and perform deep-dive analysis to identify key performance drivers, translating findings into operational action items that capitalize on strengths and mitigate financial risks.

- Business Case Review: Lead P&L assessment on proposed growth initiatives and flight network reconfiguration; perform scenario testing and synthesize financial data into clear executive summaries to guide management strategic decision making.

- Financial Advisory: Provide expert cost analysis for flight network operations, commercial pricing strategies, and new business development initiatives to drive profitable growth.

You will be a great fit if you
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, preferably with an MBA and/or CPA/ACCA/CFA.

- Experience: Minimum five years’ relevant working experience

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
- Advanced knowledge of project management and proficiency in Excel usage, Oracle Essbase and SQL

- Capability to use AI tools (e.g. GEMINI, Copilot) for automating data synthesis, summarizing long-form reports, generating initial analytical commentary, building AI-assisted trend-based model would definite be advantage

- Strong sense of responsibility, detail-oriented, business acumen, and solid story-telling communication skillset

- Sound knowledge in financial management analytical tools and investment modelling

- Fluency in both written and spoken English are a must

- Candidates with less experience will be considered for the role of Regional Financial Planning & Analysis Analyst

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Our Philosophy
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. jobs.title: Manager Corporate Development
jobs.description:
Supports the activities of the corporate development department in managing the efficient formation of business combinations by FedEx Corporation and its affiliates, including acquisitions, joint ventures and equity investments.

Job Description Overview:

FedEx, a global logistics leader with over 400,000 employees worldwide, provides customers and businesses with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services. We deliver integrated solutions through our flexible, efficient, and intelligent global network.

As Manager of Corporate Development, you will play a key role in shaping the future growth trajectory of FedEx. Reporting to the Staff Director of Corporate Development, you will be responsible for evaluating and executing strategic opportunities — including mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, and joint ventures — that align with our long-term business priorities.

You will collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to assess potential transactions, monitor industry and competitive trends, and identify emerging opportunities and risks. You will support all stages of deal execution, including financial analysis, strategic evaluation, due diligence, and portfolio management, and will prepare materials and recommendations for senior leadership review. You will also help manage relationships with external stakeholders, including potential partners, target companies, investment banks, and advisors.

Essential Functions:

- Reporting to the Director of Corporate Development, this position is responsible for evaluating and executing strategic opportunities — including mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, and joint ventures — that align with our long-term business priorities.
- Collaborate with global, cross-functional teams to assess potential transactions, monitor industry and competitive trends, and identify emerging opportunities and risks.
- Support all stages of deal execution, including financial analysis, strategic evaluation, due diligence, and portfolio management, and prepare materials and recommendations for senior leadership review.
- Manage relationships with external stakeholders, including potential partners, target companies, investment banks, and advisors.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education:

- Bachelor’s degree/equivalent in finance, business, or related field.
- MBA or equivalent graduate degree strongly preferred.

Minimum Experience:

- Five (5) or more years in mergers and acquisitions, and/or private equity investment or equivalent experience, with demonstrated end-to-end transaction experience. Candidates with fewer years of experience who possess an accelerated track record of successful deal execution and strong financial acumen are also highly encouraged to apply.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- Strong financial modeling and valuation capabilities, including DCF, comparable company, precedent transaction and accretion/dilution analyses.
- Familiarity with the transportation, logistics, or supply chain tech sectors, including market dynamics and trends.
- Corporate development, corporate strategy, investment banking, private equity, venture capital, and/or management consulting experience is a plus.
- Strong deal structuring and negotiation experience, including review of legal documents such as investment agreements and merger agreements
- Industry competitive intelligence experience
- Excellent interpersonal and communication, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate across teams.
- Proven leadership in cross-functional settings with a track record of driving results.
- Strategic thinking and critical problem-solving capabilities.
- Ability to synthesize complex strategic and financial concepts and details into an executive-level narrative.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Job Conditions:

- Some travel required.

To provide technical expertise and support for planning, developing, organizing and coordinating large programs/projects.
Essential Responsibilities
1) Serve as the dedicated workforce strategy partner to 8 SLTs across a 15k+ FTE global footprint;
2) Facilitate definition of org-level workforce plans and validates alignment to Enterprise capacity-to-demand targets, global footprint rebalancing, and approved funding models;
3) Reconciles funded vs. onboard positions and vacancy posture at each SLT level, resolving variances;
4) Manages the handoff into the approval and execution pipeline, ensuring plans are decision-ready rather than returned for re-work.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Required capability profile:  This position is scoped to the current state demands of the strategy.
1) Analytical depth. Builds and interrogates workforce models including funded vs. onboard reconciliations, vacancy and attrition posture, scenario modeling vs. Enterprise targets. Must be able to construct the analysis independently and defend the assumptions to executive leadership.
2) Applied AI fluency. Uses AI tooling and structured prompting to compress analytical cycle time, synthesizing org-level plan submissions, drafting and iterating executive-ready content, and standardized recurring analysis across the SLT orgs. This is a working requirement, not a familiarity requirement.
3) Executive translation. Converts modeling output into decisions SLTs can act on, and into packages that clear Finance, HR, and TA review.

Minimum Education
Bachelor’s Degree/equivalent in business or related quantitative discipline.
Minimum Experience
Five (5) years exempt experience in project/program management, product development, systems design/development or business /financial planning and analysis. Experience in the use of project management/planning software. Experience in planning major projects including development of project proposals, business cases, schedules, and financial justification.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
The Digital Print Manager – Tier 1 is responsible for successfully overseeing the production and distribution of orders forwarded to the Tier 1 plant from FedEx Office center locations or other channels (e-commerce, etc.); coordinate facility management to include supervision of team members; managing the business financials to varying demands; and ensuring overall business objectives are met.

GENERAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :
(This is a representative list of the general duties the position may be asked to perform, and is not intended to be all-inclusive)
- Direct supervision of team members in manufacturing plant, including responsibility for:
- Hiring of team members and monitoring new hire orientation procedures
- Training and evaluating the efficiency and productivity of team members by establishing performance standards and objectives; conducting regular Operations Reviews and Performance Appraisals and making recommendations for wage increase and promotions, when applicable; ensuring execution on all people related initiatives (i.e. bench planning, climate survey follow up)
- Initiating disciplinary procedures, as necessary, for team members, up to and including termination of employment
- Ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and company audits, as immediate supervisor of team members
- Ensuring a positive customer experience, to include business partners in the retail network
- Plan, organize and direct the manufacturing and maintenance operations which ensure the most effective return on assets
- Manage processes to minimize manufacturing costs through effective utilization of labor, equipment, facilities, materials, and capital
- Meet business objectives and productions schedules while ensuring product standards that will exceed our customers’ expectations
- Lead manufacturing strategies and action plans to ensure that the facility supports strategic initiatives

- Assist internal departments with different treasury needs that support growth.
- Support the initiatives to increase banking infrastructure and cash management processes.

- Identify fraudulent activity, financial risks, and treasury while developing mitigation strategies.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Manager Operations - Singapore Ground Operations
jobs.description:
On Road; Handling; Dispatch; Service Assurance; Network Control; Transport Scheduling; Customer Service; Contract Management/ Sourcing; Domestic Special Services; Weight & Balance; Commercial Airline Management; Spot Management; Lift; Hub Control Centre; Clearance & Brokerage Operations; Clearance Admin Inbound/ Outbound; Export Controls; Customer Services; Dangerous Goods; Cross-border Linehaul; Vendor Management; Admin & Support; Weight & Balance (Ramp Operations); Pick Up & Delivery; Domestic Hub Operations; Linehaul Operations; Road Linehaul (Transport Scheduling, Fleet Management); GSP Management (Domestic); Property & Facilities; Quality Management; Contingency Planning; Vehicle & Equipment Maintenance; Return to Work
Manager Operations - Ground Operations
We are looking for an Operations Manager based in Singapore to lead a team of Ground Operations employees and collaborate with internal/external business partners.

Job Description Summary
To effectively manage assigned Operational resources, ensuring that department or operational goals are achieved, and processes and procedures are completed promptly and consistently. Ensures that all activities are in line with enterprise goals and regulatory requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities
- People and Performance Management: Lead, recruit, develop, empower, motivate and manage team performance. Provides guidelines, support and coaching to ensure that team members have the competencies, capabilities and tools to consistently deliver individual and team objectives. As a People Manager, you will be responsible for the employee life cycle of your division including hiring, developing, discipline management and termination.
- Processes and Procedures: Oversee daily operations performance, ensuring shipments are picked up, sorted, and dispatched accurately and on time. Ensures team awareness of current processes and procedures, and relevant Company and regulatory requirements, which may impact the operation or department.
- Takes steps to ensure any changes are implemented: Ensures completion of audit and reviews of existing processes or documentation to ensure appropriate standards and rules are applied. Identifies and investigates anomalies, issues or variance to be addressed and implements corrective actions to ensure compliance and/or create improvements in process and procedures.
- Reporting and Data Management: Arranges completion of accurate and timely reporting across area of responsibility. Provides reports, presentations and relevant information to senior management as required. Ensures the effective development and use of information or record management systems or reporting practices. Monitor KPIs including service quality, transit time, loss & damage, and cost efficiency; take corrective actions where required
- Planning: Plans and schedules resources, including rostering, to ensure department priorities are completed. Communicates targets and goals to the team. Provides updates on progress towards goals for senior management and team. In order to ensure ongoing team capability to deliver both current and future job requirements and to support the growth of the business. Evaluates short/medium term resource requirements.
- Project Management: Oversees team projects/initiatives in order to deliver planned results on time and within budget. Supports the team using project management tools and processes to plan, control and execute various project /programs.
- Continuous Improvement: Continuously seeks to develop and improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the team by applying Quality Driven Management (QDM) principles. Establish a customer-centric culture focused on delivery reliability and service quality
- Budget Management: Manages department/location budget and takes appropriate actions in order to optimize costs and to remain within agreed parameters. May include involvement in vendor management and/or procurement.

Requirements:
- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in any field
- Experience Five (5) years’ experience in logistics/express courier/transport industry, process engineering, industrial engineering or other relevant experiences.
- Valid Class 3/3A Singapore Driving License or ability to immediately convert/obtain a class 3/3A Singapore Driving License
- Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Strong organizational, time management, and decision-making skills
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

Work Location:
FedEx South Pacific Hub
90 ALPS Avenue, Airport Logistics Park, Singapore 498746
